Yes, please go ahead and start building it. That list matches what we worked through together, and I'm comfortable with it as the first round of work. Setting the readable page-copy idea aside for a later round is fine by me — I know it's written down and we'll come back to it.

Just so we're on the same page about what I'll be looking for when you show me the finished thing, a couple of small things I flagged along the way that I want to make sure actually make it in: the search shouldn't care about capital letters, and when I'm labeling something it should point me to my existing labels as I type so I don't end up with near-duplicates. Nothing new — just the details I already raised.

I'm glad with where this landed. Build it, and show me when it's working.
